I would like to share that I have been following up on this matter since the very initial days of booking my apartment at Runwal Garden City Dombivli . At first, I had booked a 1 BHK and even paid the booking amount. After multiple reminders and mails, that amount was later adjusted against my current 2 BHK booking.

At the time of booking, the marketing team shared the catalog with me and informed me that a 2 BHK includes car parking. This was one of the main reasons why I chose to upgrade to a 2 BHK over a 1 BHK, and accordingly I proceeded with the booking. Both Ms. Keertika Rao and Ms. Khushi assured me that I would be getting a car parking, but at that stage I was not fully aware of the cost sheet and detailed proceedings.

On the day of the agreement, I even called Ms. Keertika to clarify about the car parking and possession timeline, since the agreement mentioned a period of two years. She assured me that I need not worry, that arrangements would be made, and that possession would be close to the catalog’s mentioned date.

Since then, I have been consistently following up for years, but unfortunately never received a proper response or resolution. As a customer, I have always cleared my dues on time and waited patiently for a transparent communication channel to address this issue.

While I am truly thankful for your recent mail, I regret that even after years of follow-up there has been neither consideration nor resolution of the car parking matter. I understand paperwork and approvals may be required, but I sincerely request that this long-pending issue be given due attention and resolved.

Looking forward to your kind support.
